seances.question: What was left unfinished at the end of this session, and what two commands remained for the operator to run?
seances.answer:
The module itself was done and verified — C:\AI\hydra-local\module\SessionDiary, a Hydra V2 door on port 8134 that generated 458 session pages (17 MB, largest 456 KB), with fork/restart/talk-to-the-dead all exercised on real sessions, plus wiring into Basic_App/electron/main.cjs DOOR_TABLE and a new "Diaries" tab. What was left unfinished was the live door: the first server was still running the pre-fix code, holding 8134 as PID 13436, so ask/diary from the page failed with "Invalid argument" (the fixed code was only live on 8135), and the agent's kill kept hitting approval prompts that timed out. The two commands handed to the operator were:

    taskkill /F /PID 13436
    cd /c/AI/hydra-local/module/SessionDiary && node public/js/main.js

The session then ran out on a side quest for elevated access — the `hermes-elevated` scheduled task got registered, the daemon (C:\AI\bin\elev\elevated-daemon.ps1) was never tested, and the transcript ends with the agent waiting for the operator to relaunch via `hermes --resume latest` from an Administrator terminal, with PID 13436 still unreaped and the Diaries tab target still unconfirmed.
